## What's new

- Updating shows its steps under "Update to <version>": Download
  ("connecting..." until data arrives, then a percentage), Check and
  Unpack (moving dots), then Install, each marked done as it finishes.
- The menu's Updates row says "connecting" rather than 0% before the
  download begins.

---

ChaOS 0.10.4 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.10.4-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.10.4-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
